title: A Rising Multiple-Dose Tolerability, Safety, and Pharmacokinetic Study of Intravenous Tildrakizumab in Patients With Psoriasis
protocol: Take baseline assessments the evening before dosing.
Give study medication after an overnight fast and 2 hours before the first meal.
Randomize subjects at a 3 active to 1 placebo ratio.
Administer tildrakizumab IV over 1 hour in doses of 0.1 mg/kg, 0.5 mg/kg, 3 mg/kg, or 10 mg/kg according to cohort assignment.
Observe an 8-week safety period between drug administrations for each subject.
Perform safety assessments and obtain PK samples on Day 2.
Conduct a closeout visit within 14 days of the last safety and PK assessment.
Enroll up to 40 subjects with psoriasis in Part 2.
Assign subjects into two dose cohorts (Cohorts 5 and 6).
Give 3 doses of 3 mg/kg tildrakizumab IV at Week 0, 4, and 8 for Cohort 5 subjects.
Randomize subjects in a 3:1 ratio of active to placebo.
Administer 3 doses of 10 mg/kg tildrakizumab IV to subjects in Cohort 6 at Week 0, 4, and 8.
Obtain serum pharmacokinetic samples predose and at the intervals specified.
Subjects receive Dose 2 and 3 of tildrakizumab during visits on Days 28 and 56.
Schedule a closeout visit within 14 days of the last PK assessment.
